heroText: Húsavík works best as a base in Iceland when you anchor days around Whale watching harbour, Husavik Whale Museum and GeoSea baths. Use those sights to understand the city's history, street life and visitor rhythm. Akureyri International Airport (AEY) handles the main arrival flow, so hotel choice should balance the centre, transfer time and day-trip plans.
